name: Convert File
label: Spreadsheet / CSV / JSON / ICS conversion
description: Converts a platform file ref to CSV, XLSX, ODS, JSON, HTML, RTF, text, or ICS. RFC 4180 CSV, RFC 5545 iCalendar, ECMA-376 XLSX and ODF ODS via JDK zip+XML. Legacy OLE2 XLS is omitted (cannot be produced without a library). Input and output are type file. No Office-site scrape. Size and row caps apply.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Convert File operation. INPUT operation overrides config. file is required (platform file ref). sheet selects a workbook sheet by name or 0-based index. file_name, header_row, encoding override the same-named config. Example: operation=to_csv with a CSV or XLSX file.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: to_csv | to_xlsx | to_ods | to_json | to_html | to_rtf | to_text | to_ics. Required on this port when config operation is blank. to_xls is not accepted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Source file ref. Required for every operation. Type file (sandbox path, ContentBlock, or $fileRef). Never inline bytes on the wire.

schema.label: sheet
schema.description: Worksheet name or 0-based index. Used when the source is XLSX/ODS. Falls back to config sheet, then the first sheet.

schema.label: file_name
schema.description: Output file name (not a file ref). Falls back to config file_name, then a name derived from the sheet / 'converted' plus the target extension.

schema.label: header_row
schema.description: First row is a header. Default true. Used by to_json (objects vs arrays), to_html (thead), to_ics (column names). Override for config header_row.

schema.label: encoding
schema.description: Text charset for CSV/JSON/HTML/RTF/text/ICS read+write. Default UTF-8. Unknown names raise INVALID_INPUT.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (status/data) plus file (type file ContentBlock) and outputFiles. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Result file ref when the operation produces a file. Type file (platform ref-id). Never inline bytes.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload (parsed JSON or engine result). Absent when unused.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status when the op is an official HTTP call. Absent for in-process ops.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Target format. EXACT accepted values: to_csv | to_xlsx | to_ods | to_json | to_html | to_rtf | to_text | to_ics. Required. Legacy to_xls is omitted. Example: 'to_csv'.

configurationParameters.label: File Name
configurationParameters.description: Output file name string (not a file ref). Overridable from INPUT file_name.

configurationParameters.label: Sheet
configurationParameters.description: Worksheet name or 0-based index for XLSX/ODS sources. Overridable from INPUT sheet.

configurationParameters.label: Header Row
configurationParameters.description: First row is header. Default true. Overridable from INPUT header_row.

configurationParameters.label: Encoding
configurationParameters.description: Text encoding for text formats. Default UTF-8. Overridable from INPUT encoding.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Run budget in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. In-process conversion; keep at or below the sandbox request budget. Example: 25.
